claims.claim: PRIMARY reconciliation supports exact canonically reviewed PASS Result preservation, validates its TASK/RUN/artifact/review identity and source root lineage, and retains exact-target reset and clean postconditions.
The existing FAILURE proof validator and H1R upstream, worktree, ignored-content, submodule, target-drift, postcondition and restart-generation gates remain in place.

Preservation selection requires one exact candidate across the supported families; reviewed proofs reject missing, malformed, mismatched, substituted, conflicting, ambiguous, non-PASS or moved transport before reset or RUN admission.
Reviewed reconciliation proves every local-only commit reachable from the exact preservation candidate and repeats both identity and complete-history proofs before destructive mutation.

Only operator.py and test_operator.py changed. Reconciliation treats reviewed transport as reachability proof, without publication, remote-ref mutation, lifecycle fabrication, roadmap advancement, persistent reconciliation state or automatic retry.

Added focused regressions model RUN-262-004-shaped DELTA PASS preservation with an unpublished predecessor, PRIMARY preservation, merge ancestry, adversarial proof rejection and mutation-edge movement; existing failure-preservation regressions remain unchanged.
